Hi Lauren / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying questions so we can decide whether Hosted API will work for our EU customers or if we need a Dedicated/Private deployment: 

- Requirement: Customer data for Spanish and Portuguese users must remain in EU and must not be routed outside EU for processing or KV cache storage.
- Scale: initial pilot ~50k requests/day, expected to double over 6 months. Latency target: p95 < 400ms for single-turn prompts.
- Security: we need to understand KMS options, support for customer-managed keys, and network isolation (VPC peering / private link).

Questions:
1) Is Redwood Hosted API available with guaranteed EU-only processing (no cross-region routing) for the models we discussed, or does Hosted sometimes route to other regions for some model variants?
2) If Hosted cannot guarantee residency, can Dedicated capacity be provisioned in our preferred EU region (Frankfurt/Amsterdam) quickly, and what are lead times?
3) For Private VPC/on-prem, can you share the typical timeline and what artifacts you need from us (network ranges, firewall rules, procurement)?

We'd like a short follow-up call with your solutions team + security to validate the option we choose. Can you share a short recommendation and next steps?

Thanks,

Hi Carlos — thanks for the clear recap, and great to meet you today. Short answers and proposed next steps below.

Summary answers:
- Hosted API (EU region): We operate EU-hosted endpoints (Frankfurt and Amsterdam) and can serve traffic entirely within EU for most open-model variants. That said, for some specialized model variants or fallbacks we may route to other regions unless the tenant is pinned to a Dedicated or Private deployment.
- Dedicated capacity: Yes — Dedicated GPU pools can be reserved in your chosen region. Typical lead time for initial provisioning is 2-4 weeks depending on capacity and contract terms.
- Private VPC / on-prem: This is the most prescriptive option for strict residency and network isolation; typical onboarding 4-8 weeks (procurement & network coordination dependent).

Recommended next steps (what I'll do / what we need from you):
- I will loop in Marissa from Solutions (cc'd internally) to confirm exact model compatibility and whether we can avoid cross-region fallbacks for the models you care about.
- Please send: expected QPS, latency SLOs, and whether you require customer-managed KMS.
- Propose a 30-min technical sync tomorrow or Friday with Marissa (Solutions) + our security SME to review KMS, VPC options, and procurement checklist.

Quick ask items (can reply inline):
- Confirm whether the 50k/day estimate is peak or average.
- Any compliance docs you need up front (SOC2, DPA templates)? We can attach our standard pack.

I'll attach the region availability PDF that outlines which regions support which model families and where fallbacks may occur.

Thanks — Lauren
